chapter: The Washingtonians, Bechet and drum style
title: Early drum training in school
summary: Crouch asks whether his only training came from Holland; Greer says he learned rudiments and reading in high school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I was going to ask you -- let's just go to the end. So the only training that you had as a drummer was the training that you got from this drummer that you heard in the show named Peggy?
Started learning the rudiments and in school.

Yeah, in school too, because they played a lot of classical stuff, like that, you know. A lot of classical stuff. We had a band, 25 or 30 pieces, violins and everything. You know how high schools are. We rehearsed a lot.
This was an integrated high school you went to.
So there was one school, but there wasn't --
